NUMBER 14 OF 2020
CONCERNING
EMPOWERMENT AND PROTECTION OF WOMEN
I. GENERAL
The Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates Regional Governments to regulate and manage their own regions for the realization of community welfare through improvement of services, empowerment and community participation. One of the authorities of Regional Government is to make a regional policy with the aim of improving the welfare of the community in its region.

In addition, the constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has also mandated in Article 28D Paragraph (1) of the 1945 Constitution that every person has the right to recognition, guarantee, protection, and fair legal certainty as well as equal treatment before the law. Article 28B Paragraph (2) of the 1945 Constitution also states that every child has the right to survival, growth and development and has the right to protection from violence and discrimination. This shows that women should be protected by the state, particularly against violence because their rights are already regulated in the constitution.

Protection carried out by the Government towards women is concretely implemented, namely by the issuance of Law Number 7 of 1984 concerning Ratification of the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination Against Women, hereinafter abbreviated as CEDAW.

The government's efforts in protecting its citizens, especially women, are also clearly implied in the provisions of Article 3 paragraph (2) of Law Number 39 of 1999 concerning Human Rights which states that: "every person has the right to recognition, guarantee, protection and fair legal treatment as well as to obtain legal certainty and equal treatment before the law".

Violence and trafficking against women are already regulated in Law Number 39 of 1999 concerning Human Rights, Law Number 23 of 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence, and Law Number 21 of 2007 concerning the Eradication of the Criminal Act of Human Trafficking.

Therefore, it is necessary to make efforts to prevent and eradicate all forms of discrimination and violence against women, particularly for the Temanggung Regency area. The Government of Temanggung Regency is one of the most authorized parties in carrying out women's empowerment in order to provide guarantees for justice and gender equality, through efforts to build commitment to integrate gender responsive budgets in programs and activities.

This Regional Regulation is expected to be able to encourage improvement efforts on access, control, participation and benefits for justice and gender equality as well as the physical and mental conditions of women victims of violence.
